executive_summary: Measure only a new numeric-key offset candidate on STP oldest, deep-book and cancel churn. Reuse current numeric-vector timings; this is an unpaired historical comparison, not an official score.

compaction.bound: len(keys) <= 2 * live_levels + 63 for certified storage; empty books reset immediately

diagnostics: One untimed instrumented candidate run records head/middle/tail removals, prefix reuse, compactions and rebuild reasons. Exact journals and gates must pass.
limitations: Actual level list still shifts; middle key changes still shift.
Slice mutations rebuild on the next ordered search.
Historical timings are reused; no old image timing launches.
Only the three specified public units are run; no full regression.
